# VOLT-X Motorsports USA Inc.

> VOLT-X Motorsports is a premier American manufacturer and distributor of high-output electric dirt bikes, 72V/80V/97V off-road e-motos, street-legal dual-sport e-motos, pit bikes, and high-energy lithium battery power packs.

## Core Offerings
- **Electric Dirt Bikes**: High-voltage machines competing with Surron Light Bee X, Ultra Bee, Storm Bee, Talaria Sting R, and E-Ride Pro SS.
- **E-Bikes & Passenger Bikes**: Heavy-duty 2-seater e-bikes, dual-battery long-range cruisers, and commuter dirt e-bikes.
- **Batteries & Upgrades**: 60V, 72V, 80V, 81V, 97V high-capacity lithium-ion replacement and race packs, fast chargers, sine-wave vector controllers, IPM brushless motors, and billet armor.

## Shipping & Service
- **Free Freight Shipping**: 100% free insured crate freight delivery across all 50 US States.
- **Warranty**: 2-Year Factory Battery & Controller Warranty included with every vehicle purchase.
